selection: The five largest optimization-only medians from accepted round29; no holdout measurement, profile or per-case selection. No source changes; accepted source and driver identity checked.
method: Call count estimates driver/cache-flush overhead from preceding completed optimization profiles and adds each current frozen kernel median, targeting16 wall seconds with margin for the fixed sample window. Counts do not enter scores. One sequential driver per case; macOS sample PID 6 1 after a 1s startup delay; any startup stacks are excluded from canonical execute attribution. Reported attribution includes only canonical execute stacks; parsing, JIT, input import, cache flush and serialization are excluded by stack. Profiled sample times do not enter benchmark scores.
